data.name: Blood & Silence
data.detailed_description:
"She is not going to be a hero. She is going to be the thing that happens to people who thought they were safe."

Blood & Silence is a visceral third-person survival horror experience that violently strips away the power fantasy of revenge, leaving only the cold, crushing weight of grief. Set in the decaying metropolis of Ashvale—a dying city where Victorian gothic architecture bleeds into 1990s industrial grime—you will navigate a profoundly personal descent into trauma, survival, and the unbearable cost of moving forward.

A SYMPHONY OF GRIEF

Mara Cole was never trained for this. She was a 34-year-old payroll administrator. She was a wife. She was a mother. She remembers the warmth of her daughter's drawings and the mundane comfort of Friday dinners. After witnessing the brutal murder of her family and clawing her way out of a shallow forest grave, that woman died. What remains is the mechanical necessity of action. Mara isn't a highly trained operative or a fearless survivor. She is utterly terrified. Her hands shake uncontrollably. Her breathing betrays her in the dark. You must help her survive a city that wants her dead, using only an accountant's cold patience and a rage that has frozen solid.

THE 14-B PROTOCOL: GREY NIGHT

In Ashvale, the law is a meticulously managed lie. Every last Saturday of the month, from 23:00 to 05:00, the city enters Grey Night. Emergency dispatch goes permanently dark. The streets are surrendered to the strong. As the clock ticks closer to 11 PM, the ordinary hum of the city drains away, replaced by the suffocating, terrifying silence of sanctioned lawlessness. You must navigate entire districts transformed by this protocol, facing independent cults, desperate opportunists, and the unrelenting grip of the Carvelo Synthetic network.

TRAUMA AND ADAPTATION

Forget experience points. Forget skill trees. Blood & Silence replaces generic progression with a grounded, agonizing Trauma and Adaptation system.

  • The Body Keeps the Score: Every violent encounter extracts a toll. Mara’s aim tightens not through "leveling up," but as she painfully learns to shoot within the adrenaline-fueled shake of her own terror.

  • Permanent Consequences: Untreated wounds become persistent nightmares. A brutal fall leaves a permanent limp; a knife wound restricts your reach for the rest of the game.

  • Psychological Decay: Excessive violence degrades Mara’s sleep and hollows out her expressions, slowly and irreversibly closing her off from the woman she once was.

BRUTAL, SYSTEMIC SURVIVAL

There is no pausing for safety. Your inventory is a physical bag managed in real-time panic.

  • Mechanically Honest Combat: Weapons are heavy, deafening, and desperately unreliable. Ammunition is terrifyingly scarce. A jammed pump-action shotgun in a pitch-black corridor isn't an inconvenience—it's a death sentence. You must clear jams, bandage profusely bleeding wounds, and reload in real-time while listening to footsteps approaching in the fog.

  • Read the Environment: Mara is an auditor, not a thief. There are no lockpicking minigames. To bypass security, you must read the world exactly like she does: cross-reference betting ledgers, decipher Victorian-era freight codes, and find the fatal errors in corrupt systems that everyone else ignores.

THE UNHURRIED HUNTER

You cannot kill Harrow. The network’s chief enforcer does not run, and he does not shout theatrical threats. He follows the sound of your frantic breathing, the disturbed dust, and the trail of your blood with professional, terrifying patience. When you hear the low-frequency hum of his approaching presence, your only options are to hide, manage your oxygen so your lungs don't involuntarily gasp, and pray to a god that left Ashvale a long time ago that he moves on.

Ashvale does not offer closure. It only offers the terrifying question of who you become when the purpose is finally removed.

data.short_description: Blood & Silence is a brutal third-person survival horror game driven by grief. Navigate the decaying city of Ashvale as an ordinary woman pushed to the edge. Manage real-time inventory, clear weapon jams under fire, hold your breath to hide, and survive unrelenting psychological trauma.
data.supported_languages:

*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 65 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended. (1080p / 30 FPS / Low-Medium Settings). Game optimization and updates are ongoing.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 65 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Solid State Drive (SSD) is mandatory. (1080p or 1440p / 60 FPS / High Settings). Game optimization and updates are ongoing.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (Vulkan Support Required)
  • Storage: 65 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended. Game optimization and updates are ongoing.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit) or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (Vulkan Support Required)

content_descriptors.notes: BLOOD & SİLENCE contains intense scenes of graphic violence, gore, disturbing imagery, and psychological horror throughout the entire experience. Players will encounter brutal enemy encounters, visceral combat, mutilated remains, and highly disturbing environmental storytelling. The game features strong language and depicts themes of grief, emotional trauma, and psychological distress. There is no sexual content or nudity. This game is intended for mature audiences only.
